per_question.question: Where does Brightleaf Robotics have offices?
per_question.answer: Brightleaf Robotics has offices in Pune, Berlin and Toronto [hr_handbook.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: What are the core working hours?
per_question.answer: Core working hours are 10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Friday [hr_handbook.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: How many hours per week must employees work?
per_question.answer: Employees must work 40 hours per week, and they can choose their start and finish times outside core hours (10:00 to 16:00, Monday to Friday) [hr_handbook.pdf, p.1]. They must record their hours in the TimeTrack portal by 18:00 every Friday [hr_handbook.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: By when must hours be recorded in TimeTrack?
per_question.answer: Employees must record their hours in the TimeTrack portal by 18:00 every Friday [hr_handbook.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: How long is the probation period for new employees?
per_question.answer:
New employees serve a probation period of 6 months [hr_handbook.pdf, p.2]. During probation, either side may end employment with 2 weeks' notice [hr_handbook.pdf, p.2].

Interns have a separate probation period of 1 month [intern_policy.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: What is the notice period during probation?
per_question.answer:
The notice period depends on the type of engagement:

- **Employees:** During the 6-month probation period, either side may end employment with 2 weeks' notice [hr_handbook.pdf, p.2].
- **Interns:** Interns may end the internship with 1 week's notice, and the internship has a probation period of 1 month [intern_policy.pdf, p.1].

The excerpts do not give a probation-specific notice period for contractors. They only state that either side may end a contractor engagement with 30 days' written notice [contractor_policy.pdf, p.3].

per_question.question: What is the notice period for managers after probation?
per_question.answer: After probation, the notice period for managers is 3 months [hr_handbook.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time employees get?
per_question.answer: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per year, in addition to public holidays [hr_handbook.pdf, p.3].

per_question.question: How many unused annual leave days can be carried over?
per_question.answer:
Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over, and carried-over days expire on 31 March [hr_handbook.pdf, p.3].

This applies to full-time employees. The excerpts do not state a carry-over rule for interns.

per_question.question: When do carried-over leave days expire?
per_question.answer: Carried-over annual leave days expire on 31 March. Up to 5 unused days may be carried over [hr_handbook.pdf, p.3].

per_question.question: How many paid sick days do employees get per year?
per_question.answer:
Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per year [hr_handbook.pdf, p.3]. A doctor's note is needed for absences longer than 3 consecutive working days [hr_handbook.pdf, p.3].

Interns are covered separately and receive 5 days of paid sick leave [intern_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: When is a doctor's note needed for sick leave?
per_question.answer:
A doctor's note is needed for sick leave absences longer than 3 consecutive working days [hr_handbook.pdf, p.3].

This applies to employees, who receive 12 days of paid sick leave per year [hr_handbook.pdf, p.3]. The intern policy gives interns 5 days of paid sick leave [intern_policy.pdf, p.2], but the excerpts do not say whether the doctor's note requirement also applies to interns.

per_question.question: How much parental leave do birthing parents get?
per_question.answer: Birthing parents receive 26 weeks of fully paid parental leave [hr_handbook.pdf, p.4].

per_question.question: How much parental leave do non-birthing parents get?
per_question.answer: Non-birthing parents receive 6 weeks of fully paid parental leave, to be taken within the child's first year [hr_handbook.pdf, p.4].

per_question.question: How many days of compassionate leave can employees take?
per_question.answer: Employees may take up to 5 days of paid compassionate leave after the death of a close family member [hr_handbook.pdf, p.4].

per_question.question: Up to what percentage does the company match pension contributions?
per_question.answer: The company matches pension contributions up to 6% of base salary [hr_handbook.pdf, p.5].

per_question.question: What is the annual learning budget?
per_question.answer:
The annual learning budget depends on your role:

- **Employees:** 1,500 EUR per year, for courses, books and conferences [hr_handbook.pdf, p.5].
- **Interns:** 300 EUR [intern_policy.pdf, p.3].

The documents do not state a learning budget for contractors. The contractor policy excerpt does not mention one.

per_question.question: How much is the monthly wellness allowance?
per_question.answer: The monthly wellness allowance is 50 EUR, and it can be used for gym memberships or fitness classes [hr_handbook.pdf, p.5].

per_question.question: How many days per week can employees work remotely?
per_question.answer:
Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with their manager's agreement [hr_handbook.pdf, p.6].

Interns have a different allowance: they may work remotely 1 day per week [intern_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: How much is the home office allowance?
per_question.answer: The home office allowance is a one-time payment of 400 EUR, paid during the first month of employment [hr_handbook.pdf, p.6].

per_question.question: Above what value must supplier gifts be declared?
per_question.answer: Gifts from suppliers worth more than 75 EUR must be declared to the compliance team [hr_handbook.pdf, p.6].

per_question.question: What is the minimum password length?
per_question.answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long [it_security_policy.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: Do passwords need to be rotated regularly?
per_question.answer: No. Passwords only need to be changed if a compromise is suspected, and routine rotation is not required [it_security_policy.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: After how many failed sign-in attempts is an account locked?
per_question.answer: Accounts are locked after 10 failed sign-in attempts [it_security_policy.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: Which systems require multi-factor authentication?
per_question.answer: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, VPN and the HR portal [it_security_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: After how many minutes of inactivity must laptops lock the screen?
per_question.answer: Laptops must lock the screen after 5 minutes of inactivity [it_security_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: How can personal phones access company email?
per_question.answer: Personal phones may access company email only through the approved Intune app [it_security_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: How quickly must suspected security incidents be reported?
per_question.answer: Suspected security incidents must be reported to the security team within 1 hour of discovery [it_security_policy.pdf, p.3].

per_question.question: Which extension should I call to report a lost laptop?
per_question.answer: Report a lost laptop to the IT helpdesk on extension 4400 [it_security_policy.pdf, p.3]. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to that extension, and you should also report any suspected security incident to the security team within 1 hour of discovery [it_security_policy.pdf, p.3].

per_question.question: How should phishing emails be reported?
per_question.answer: Phishing emails should be reported using the Report Phish button in Outlook [it_security_policy.pdf, p.3].

per_question.question: What are the data classification levels?
per_question.answer: Data is classified into four levels: Public, Internal, Confidential and Restricted [it_security_policy.pdf, p.4].

per_question.question: Where may restricted data such as salaries be stored?
per_question.answer: Restricted data, such as salary information, may only be stored on the encrypted HR drive [it_security_policy.pdf, p.4].

per_question.question: Who must approve sharing confidential documents outside the company?
per_question.answer: Confidential documents must not be shared outside the company without approval from the data owner [it_security_policy.pdf, p.4].

per_question.question: Which AI assistant may be used for company data?
per_question.answer:
Employees may use only the approved internal AI assistant for company data [it_security_policy.pdf, p.5]. Confidential or Restricted data must never be pasted into public AI chatbots [it_security_policy.pdf, p.5].

The excerpts do not name the specific assistant.

per_question.question: Where must developers keep system prompts?
per_question.answer: Developers who build AI features must keep system prompts in version control and review them like code [it_security_policy.pdf, p.5].

per_question.question: How far in advance must business travel be booked?
per_question.answer: All business travel must be booked through the TravelDesk portal at least 10 days before departure [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: Who must approve trips abroad?
per_question.answer: Trips abroad require approval from the department head [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: Which class must be booked for flights under 5 hours?
per_question.answer: Economy class is required for flights under 5 hours [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: When may premium economy be booked?
per_question.answer: Premium economy may be booked for flights of 5 hours or more [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.2]. For flights under 5 hours, economy class is required [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: When is train travel preferred over flying?
per_question.answer: Train travel is preferred over flying for journeys under 4 hours [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: What is the hotel limit per night in capital cities?
per_question.answer: Hotels are reimbursed up to 180 EUR per night in capital cities [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.3].

per_question.question: What is the daily meal allowance outside Europe?
per_question.answer: The daily meal allowance outside Europe is 60 EUR [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.3].

per_question.question: Is alcohol reimbursed?
per_question.answer: No, alcohol is not reimbursed [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.3].

per_question.question: What is the mileage rate for using a private car?
per_question.answer: Use of a private car is reimbursed at 0.30 EUR per kilometre [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.4].

per_question.question: Within how many days must expense claims be submitted?
per_question.answer: Expense claims must be submitted within 60 days of the expense, with receipts [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.4].

per_question.question: Who must approve expense claims above 2,000 EUR?
per_question.answer: Claims above 2,000 EUR require approval from the finance director [travel_expense_policy.pdf, p.4].

per_question.question: Do contractors receive paid annual leave?
per_question.answer: No. Contractors do not receive paid annual leave [contractor_policy.pdf, p.1]. Any unpaid time off must be agreed with the engagement manager 2 weeks in advance [contractor_policy.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: How far in advance must contractors agree unpaid time off?
per_question.answer: Contractors must agree unpaid time off with the engagement manager 2 weeks in advance [contractor_policy.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: By when must contractors send their monthly invoice?
per_question.answer: Contractors must invoice monthly, by the 5th working day of the following month [contractor_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: Within how many days are contractor invoices paid?
per_question.answer: Contractor invoices are paid within 30 days of receipt [contractor_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: What notice is needed to end a contractor engagement?
per_question.answer: Either side may end a contractor engagement with 30 days' written notice [contractor_policy.pdf, p.3]. Contractors must also return all company property and access badges on their last day [contractor_policy.pdf, p.3].

per_question.question: How many days of paid annual leave do interns get?
per_question.answer: Interns receive 10 days of paid annual leave per year, pro rata for shorter internships [intern_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: How many days per week can interns work remotely?
per_question.answer: Interns may work remotely 1 day per week [intern_policy.pdf, p.2].

per_question.question: How long is the probation period for interns?
per_question.answer: Interns have a probation period of 1 month [intern_policy.pdf, p.1].

per_question.question: What is the learning budget for interns?

per_question.question: How many hours per week do interns work?
per_question.answer: Interns work 30 hours per week, scheduled with their mentor [intern_policy.pdf, p.1].
